description: This file defines the class `CashierRepositoryWrapper`, a Spring service that wraps a repository to handle retrieval of cashier entities with not-found detection.

classes.name: CashierRepositoryWrapper
classes.description: A Spring service class providing a wrapper around `CashierRepository` for retrieving `Cashier` entities with exception handling when not found.

methods.name: findOneWithNotFoundDetection
methods.description: Retrieves a `Cashier` by ID, throwing `TellerNotFoundException` if the entity is not found.
